name: High-engagement power users
description: Users who log in 5+ days per week, use advanced features, and have customised at least three workspace settings.

name: Onboarding stallers
description: Users who completed signup but stalled before finishing the first project setup. Average session length under 90 seconds.

name: Casual weekenders
description: Users who only access the product on weekends, with short sessions and minimal use of collaboration features.

name: Team admins
description: Workspace administrators managing permissions, billing, and integrations for teams of 5+ members.
